answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 5283 Country: Pakistan Title: I am a married and Muslim man Praying five times every day. I have a question which I can not ask form any Alim face to face I hope my question will be answered Jazakallah Khair!! My question is when I share bed (Have sex) with my wife how much naked we both can be as per Islamic law whole body or some part please answer my question in the light of Shariah so as to get me out of confusion thank You very much Question: I am a married and Muslim man Praying five times every day. I have a question which I can not ask form any Alim face to face I hope my question will be answered Jazakallah Khair!! My question is when I share bed (Have sex) with my wife how much naked we both can be as per Islamic law whole body or some part please answer my question in the light of Shariah so as to get me out of confusion thank You very much Answer ID: 5283 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 710/659=D/1429) Though seeing the entire body of wife is permissible but it is against modesty. While doing intercourse one can reveal the parts of the body only as much as necessary, but it has been prohibited in Hadith to get naked while having sex. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
